propositions: When a bug is closed as duplicate without a recorded duplicates link, close_precheck falls through to the billable completion verifier which fails with an unhelpful message and offers no mention of the rebar link command
close_precheck must hard-fail with a deterministic error before the LLM verifier when a duplicate close has no recorded replacement link, naming the exact rebar link command needed
The gate must accept a duplicates link pointing to a closed canonical ticket, requiring link existence but not target openness
A duplicates link naming an archived or unresolvable target must produce a distinct error message from the no-link case
The hard fail must apply only to duplicate class, leaving not_a_bug and escalated classes unaffected with their original fallthrough behavior
